title.note: Game title kept byte-identical (glossary keep; no official Chinese title). The guide says keep the English title rather than half-translate it.

hud.bait_left.note: Label form 'Bait: {count}' as context suggests; avoids needing a classifier before the number. No space after the full-width colon.

catch.success.note: Guide pattern for inserted rarity + name: no classifier, no space or 的 between the Chinese params (renders 你钓到了稀有金鲤鱼！). Chinese has no a/an, so the English vowel issue does not arise.

catch.escaped.note: 'It' made explicit as the generic word 鱼 (fish); 溜走 = slipped away, light tone. Trailing ASCII ... kept per the guide.

catch.new_record.note: kg written as 公斤, the everyday mainland word kids use; 'kg' would also be understood. The game's decimal point (12.4) is correct for zh-cn.

fish.lantern_eel.note: Coined name: 灯笼 (lantern) + 鳗 (eel), keeps the glowing-lantern idea and echoes the title. Natural as a cute creature name.

rarity.mythic.note: Guide tier set 普通, 稀有, 史诗, 传说, 神话: 神话 sits above 传说 (Legendary).

shop.buy_robux.note: Guide's compact price-first shop button (as in 60 钻石购买); the guide asks for a native check. Chattier alternative: 花 {price} Robux 购买.

pass.lucky_bait.text: 幸运鱼饵让你钓到稀有鱼的几率翻倍！

sell.done.text: 卖出 {count} 条鱼，赚了 {coins} 金币！
sell.done.note: 条 is the classifier for fish; reads correctly for 1 or any number. 'for {coins} coins' rendered as 赚了 (earned), spoken toast tone; currency takes no classifier per the guide.

sell.prompt.note: 'to sell' given its object 卖鱼 (sell fish) since Chinese wants one here; no 键 after a single key letter, per the guide.

ascend.button.note: Ascend as 晋升 (rise in rank): neutral, not religious, not climbing. Rejected 飞升 (idle-game prestige word but Daoist immortal-ascension flavor) and 重生 (the guide's word for Rebirth, which would erase the distinct name). Native check welcome.

ascend.confirm.text: 确定要现在晋升吗？你将从头开始，但钓到稀有鱼的几率会永久提高 {bonus}%。
ascend.confirm.note: Guide's 确定要...吗？ confirm pattern. 'start over' = 从头开始 (did not add rods/coins, which the source does not name). '{bonus}% more often' rendered as chance of catching rare fish permanently raised by {bonus}%. Medium only because of the 晋升 term choice.

weather.storm.text: 暴风雨来袭！稀有鱼开始咬钩了！
weather.storm.note: 来袭 is the usual banner wording for an arriving storm. 'are biting' = 咬钩 (taking the bait). Second sentence ends in ！ instead of a period to carry the excited banner tone the context asks for.

quest.catch_n.text: 在月光湾钓到 {n} 条鱼

friends.boost.text: 和好友一起钓鱼，获得 +{percent}% 幸运加成
friends.boost.note: Statement form 'fish with friends, get +{percent}% luck bonus'; 加成 is the guide's word for a bonus, 幸运 matches 幸运鱼饵. 好友, not 朋友 or 联系人.

codes.redeemed.text: 兑换成功！好好享受奖励吧！
codes.redeemed.note: 'Code redeemed!' as 兑换成功！, the standard Chinese redemption toast. One sentence-final particle (吧).

afk.kicked.text: 你太久没有操作，已停止钓鱼。
afk.kicked.note: 'idle' as 太久没有操作 (no input for too long), plainer for kids than 闲置; no server removal added.

settings.sfx.note: 音效 is the standard Simplified game-settings term. Lint flags 音 as Traditional-only, but 音 is identical in both scripts (only 聲/声 differ): a false positive in TRADITIONAL_ONLY in scripts/i18n.py, not an error in the text.

event.ends.note: Time phrase moved before the verb. For the developer: {time} arrives as '2d 4h' with English unit letters, which shows as '2d 4h 后结束'; readable for gamers but a Chinese formatter (2天4小时) or a clock format would read better.

daily.streak.text: 连续登录第 {day} 天！明天再来领取更多奖励吧！
daily.streak.note: Ordinal day form works for day = 1. 'for more' made explicit as 更多奖励 (more rewards), as the context says.

tip.night.text: 提示：有些鱼只在晚上咬钩。

group.join.text: 加入群组，免费领取 50 个鱼饵！
group.join.note: 群组 per the guide's Roblox vocabulary; 社区 would match the renamed Communities page if the developer prefers. 个 classifier added before bait as Chinese needs one.

leaderboard.biggest.note: 'Biggest' as 最重 (heaviest) per context; 渔获 = a catch; 榜 marks it as a leaderboard. Plainer alternative if 渔获 feels too technical for kids: 最重鱼排行榜.
